Command: Restore what was taken by robbery or fraud
Summary: One who has taken by robbery, or defrauded, or kept a deposit, or found a lost thing and denied it, must restore the principal in full and add a fifth part, and bring his trespass offering.
Commandment: Restore what was taken by robbery or fraud.
Application: Restoration goes beyond return: principal plus a fifth marks the wrong, and confession before God accompanies repayment to man. Zacchaeus shows the same spirit in the gospel (Luke 19:8) — restitution is repentance made tangible.
Purpose: To make wrongs right: what was taken by robbery or fraud is restored in full, with a fifth added, because justice restores and does not merely punish.
